noticias.titular: INTEF to present the 2026 update of its AI guide at SIMO on 13 November
noticias.entradilla: According to INTEF’s programme at SIMO EDUCACIÓN, that day was to see the presentation of the new version of its guide on the use of AI in education and another on how to integrate it into schools.
noticias.imagen_alt: A timeline under the label “13 November” with two sessions: at “10:30”, an open book labelled “AI guide”, and at “13:30”, a document labelled “Schools”.

noticias.titular: Microsoft unveils Classroom, a dedicated space to centre classwork on Microsoft 365
noticias.entradilla: Microsoft Classroom brings assignments, grades and AI tools together on a single screen for primary, secondary and higher education. It arrives in 2027 at no extra cost for schools on certain plans.
noticias.imagen_alt: A panel labelled “Classroom” with four arrows leading to four boxes labelled “Tasks”, “Grades”, “Notebook” and “AI”.

noticias.titular: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, the latter only for verified organisations
noticias.entradilla: The company announces two versions of the same model: Fable 5.2, with safeguards and no prior verification, and Mythos 5.2, only for verified organisations.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram of a trunk, “Claude 5.2”, that forks into two branches: “Fable 5.2”, which leads to a group of people labelled “No verification”, and “Mythos 5.2”, which leads to a padlocked closed door labelled “Verified”.

noticias.titular: Anthropic bans sustained, gratuitous abuse of its models in its usage policy
noticias.entradilla: The update, published on 8 October 2026, takes effect on 12 November and will be enforced only in extreme cases.
noticias.imagen_alt: A horizontal bar divided by a red line. On the left, labelled “Allowed”, three speech bubbles: two labelled “Frustration” and “Disagreement”. To the right of the line, a blue speech bubble labelled “Repeated cruelty” and, below it, a calendar labelled “From 12 Nov”.

noticias.titular: An MIT report, from August, calls for rethinking teaching and assessment in the age of AI
noticias.entradilla: The committee set up by MIT to study the use of AI in teaching, learning and research training recommends AI-aware educational processes and a review of assessments and policies.
noticias.imagen_alt: A “Report” from which three branches extend, each with its own icon: a sheet with a tick, “Assessment and rules”; two people, “People and campus”; and two arrows in a circle, “Continuous improvement”.

noticias.titular: European Commission updates DigCompEdu to include AI and digital wellbeing
noticias.entradilla: The European framework for teachers' digital competence is under revision, with a final version expected in spring 2027 and consultations with teachers.
noticias.imagen_alt: Six circles around a centre, “Judgement”, teachers' professional judgement, surrounded by a dashed ring, “AI throughout”, AI present across the whole framework; on the right, “Wellbeing”, an axis with three icons: a clock, a screen and a power button.

noticias.titular: Google unveils Gemini 4 Carbon, for now only for cybersecurity specialists
noticias.entradilla: Google DeepMind has announced its new frontier model, which for now is used only by a small group of cyber-defence professionals. There is no date for the general public.
noticias.imagen_alt: A staircase of three steps rising from left to right: the first, with a few people, is cybersecurity defence; the second, with more people, is trusted partners; the third, dashed and with a half-open padlock, is marked “no date”.
